description: Keyword search over VibeCodePicks' reviewed AI coding and AI creation tools. Use when the user names a tool or a kind of tool ('is there an AI tool for deploying my app', 'find a no-code SaaS builder') and you need tool ids. Not for 'which is best for me' (use recommend_tools). Input: `query` (plain words, e.g. 'no-code SaaS builder'); `limit` (default 5), `offset` for paging. Returns one row per tool: id|name|category|lowest paid $/month|has free tier (1/0), and the next offset. Call fetch(id) for details.

offset.description: paging offset from the previous result
